paragraphs: “In the name of Rabbi Chiyya Rabbah” — so it is cited in Yuchasin and Seder HaDorot. The rabbi who annotated it there, at note 6, wrote that in the Yuchasin before him it reads Rav Bivi with a yod; but in Yuchasin HaShalem, London, it reads Rav Bavi, and there, at note 8, he criticizes Seder HaDorot for this. Hyman considers the criticism groundless.

notes.text: The consulted Seder HaDorot has Bavi reporting Chiyya Rabbah. The comparison between the two Yuchasin readings follows Hyman’s account.
